result.title: NVIDIA cuPhoton: The Tech Fast-Tracking Space Discovery
result.description:
High in the Chilean mountains, the Rubin Observatory—home to the largest digital camera ever built—captures a staggering 20 terabytes of sky data every single night. Hidden within these petabytes are the ultimate secrets of dark matter and dark energy, which make up 95% of our universe.

The problem? Traditional workflows are slow and processing this data can take months.

Enter NVIDIA cuPhoton.

By leveraging CPU/GPU-accelerated pipelines on multi-GPU, multi-node systems, cuPhoton speeds up image loading and reading by a massive 15,000x, and accelerates data processing and analysis by up to 8,400x. What once took months can now happen in minutes.

With cuPhoton, scientists can finally load, process, and analyze multidimensional data in near real-time—including AI training and signal detection. Watch to see how NVIDIA is bringing the universe into focus, faster than ever before.

🌌 Learn more about NVIDIA cuPhoton: https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/ai-for-science-software-cuda/
